title: Research Program Manager, Model Evaluations
description:
At Globex Labs, we build tools that help teams check how well their AI models behave. This fictional posting is test data for LVLme.

About the Role

You will run the program that turns our research team's evaluation ideas into repeatable checks our customers rely on.

What you'll do

  • Plan and run the quarterly evaluation roadmap with research and engineering leads.
  • Keep a single source of truth for every evaluation, its owner and its status.
  • Write the monthly update for customers and the leadership team.
requirements:
• 5+ years of program management in a research or technical setting.
  • Clear written communication for both technical and non-technical readers.
  • Experience coordinating work across research, engineering and customer teams.

Bonus points if you have

  • Familiarity with machine learning evaluation methods.
benefits:
Why Globex Labs

  • Experience a four day week every second Friday.
  • Equity for every employee.

Globex Labs is an equal opportunity employer.
